findings.title: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changed from 4 to 3, breaking existing contract
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was previously 4 and is now changed to 3, while FEATURE_DISABLED takes the old value 4. Any existing scripts or documentation relying on exit code 4 meaning 'recreate upgrade needed' will now get incorrect behavior (3 now means recreate, 4 means feature disabled). This is a breaking change to a documented exit-code contract for a preview feature; it should be called out explicitly as a behavior change, and existing automation relying on these codes could silently misinterpret results.

findings.title: Exit code 4 documented inconsistently with CompatibilityResult
findings.body: The doc states exit code 4 means 'Rolling Upgrade is not possible. The feature rolling-updates is disabled,' which matches the new FEATURE_DISABLED=4, but combined with the exit-code renumbering (RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changed from 4 to 3) there is a risk of confusion for readers of older docs/version metadata who might have cached the previous exit-code meaning. The PR should clarify this is a breaking change in exit codes for the preview feature.
